name: San Antonio
metaDescription: Industry-specific market reports for San Antonio, Texas. Landscaping, roofing, HVAC, and pest control intelligence with local demand, pricing, and competitive data.
ogDescription: Local market reports for San Antonio operators — demand, competition, pricing, and growth opportunities by industry.
intro: San Antonio is structurally different from the other Texas metros: slower growth, less competitive churn, and meaningfully higher customer loyalty. Operators who get referral and retention flywheels right here compound for years.
statsSource: Population and households: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2024 1-year estimates for the metro area. Business count: Sherlock Research estimate.
reportsIntro: Each Sherlock industry report includes a city-specific data cut for San Antonio — local demand, competitor density, pricing benchmarks, and neighborhood-level demand patterns. Steady growth, lower competitive intensity than Austin or Dallas, and one of the most loyal home-service buyer bases in the country.

reportBlurbs.hvac: HVAC service and install market for San Antonio: heat-pump adoption, service-plan pricing, refrigerant transition impact.

insights.title: Long-tenure customers
insights.text: Average customer relationship length runs 30%+ longer than Austin or Dallas. CLV-driven business models work especially well here.

insights.title: Military-household demand
insights.text: Joint Base San Antonio creates a steady stream of relocating military households — reliable demand for movers, cleaners, and turnover service.

insights.title: Lower competitive density
insights.text: Far fewer national franchise operators per capita than Austin or DFW. Local independents have a meaningful structural advantage.
